create_ParlaiLogger: create a ParlaiLogger instance with a custom name and console log level
use_log_function: use the log function to log a message at a custom level like REPORT or SUCCESS
mute_and_unmute_logger: mute the logger to suppress stdout output and unmute to resume logging
add_format_prefix: add a format prefix to all future logging statements using add_format_prefix
set_log_level: set the global logger level to control which messages are displayed to the console
